title: Discover built-ins in the actual session before writing a UDF
brief: Search the SQL catalog, runtime registry and defining function crate. An indexed constructor is not proof of registration under a consumer's feature profile; names/aliases, signature and return-field logic are separate facts.

choices.tradeoff: Keep optimizer visibility; inspect null/coercion/volatility contracts.

choices.choose_when: Already operating on arrays inside an execution boundary
choices.tradeoff: Avoid unnecessary SQL/UDF registration but manage schema and scalar broadcasting.
Declare signature, volatility, invocation and output-field behavior; prove any optimizer hooks.

choices.choose_when: Arguments produce a relation rather than a scalar column
choices.tradeoff: Registration and output TableProvider differ from scalar functions.

claims.statement: SessionState exposes scalar/aggregate/window/table function maps. The captured registry records registered names, canonical names, aliases and signature Debug text for one explicit profile.

ScalarUDFImpl receives invocation arguments including ColumnarValue inputs and row-count/field context. Inspect invoke_with_args and return_field_from_args; scalar versus array and nullable output cannot be inferred from the SQL name.
Volatility, simplification, ordering/bounds and short-circuit hooks affect planning. Defaults may be appropriate; incorrect advertised properties can change results.
Cargo features, default function installation and session registrations all matter. Runtime registry capture is not a list of every function constructible from the 60 indexed crates.

implementation: Find a SQL name or task synonym, resolve its defining implementation and expr_fn helper.
Check actual registry membership and Cargo features.
Read the specific function's signature, coercion and return-field/null contract before composing.
unknowns: The registry signature is Debug output, not a stable signature serialization. Return-field behavior still requires per-function reading/probing.

evidence.scope: Pinned hosted rustdoc; availability depends on the consumer profile.

invalidation.reason: Review changed signatures, docs, availability, and newly viable alternatives.
